definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being weak — in strength, will, ability, or intensity. The noun form of the adjective {弱|よわ}い.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}さ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼやけた→ぼやける：16967_boyakeru⟧。
examples.english: The photo came out blurry because of the faintness of the light.

examples.japanese: {弱|よわ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧しも⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Showing weakness is not necessarily a bad thing.

notes:
The noun form of the i-adjective ⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (weak), made with the {〜さ} suffix. Covers physical, mental, and abstract weakness, as well as the faintness or low intensity of things like light or signals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}さ: weakness of heart/mind
- {弱|よわ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: admit one's weakness
- {弱|よわ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: show weakness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧: strength
